description: Leitungssystem Trinkwasser des TAV Peitz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Overview of the main pipes in the drinking water area of the Peitz administrative area provided by TAV Peitz. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water pipe system of the TAV Peitz" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
